scenes.title: Cold open: the problem with shorthand
scenes.visualPlan: Black text on light document-texture field: NO EVIDENCE? then scope cards for what, where, standard, date.
scenes.notes: No fake documents. Use typography and simple lines only.

scenes.title: The source event
scenes.visualPlan: Zoom from GAH brief URL to archived Senate hearing page and source manifest hash card.
scenes.notes: Show no official stenographic transcript located as a source-status card.

scenes.title: The exact question and the narrow category
scenes.visualPlan: Highlight the Kennedy question from the exchange ledger, then draw a boundary box around other men to whom Epstein trafficked young women.

scenes.title: The answer and its qualifiers
scenes.visualPlan: Two highlighted qualifier cards: as of now; That does not mean it did not happen. Then show reviewed-corpus versus universal-claim split.
scenes.notes: Do not add longer Blanche quotes unless reverified.

scenes.title: Records versus proof
scenes.visualPlan: Comparison table: record exists, can establish, cannot establish. Use icons for address book, calendar, photo, flight log, testimony.
scenes.notes: No person-specific names in this sequence.

scenes.title: What the public record establishes
scenes.visualPlan: Timeline: 2019 charge document, 2021 verdict, 2022 judgment, 2024 appeal. Labels distinguish party position from court finding.
scenes.notes: Do not imply Epstein conviction or unnamed third-party finding.

scenes.title: What DOJ has not publicly shown
scenes.visualPlan: Four gap cards: declination memo, credibility analysis, corroboration memo, charging analysis. Mark not publicly located.

scenes.title: Related hearing exchanges
scenes.visualPlan: Three exchange blocks: Grassley, Durbin, Kennedy. Connect to contradiction-audit counters.
scenes.notes: Keep Grassley and Durbin separate from the decisive Kennedy answer.

scenes.title: The narrow conclusion
scenes.visualPlan: Final equation: no evidence in reviewed corpus is not no records, and records are not proof by themselves. End with corrections/source invitation.
scenes.notes: End card points to corrections and package review sources.
